title: Characterization of points matching a path
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let a path on $\mathbb{F}_2^n$ specify values at some coordinates, and let $x\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$. The point $x$ agrees with every value specified by the path if and only if, at every coordinate specified by the path, $x$ equals the point that uses the path's assigned value there and $0$ at every unspecified coordinate.
